verdict.rationale: New Relic ships its own programmatic surfaces: the NerdGraph GraphQL API, an official CLI, Terraform support and an MCP server. However, its own docs say NerdGraph configures only "some" New Relic features, and nothing documents UI-to-API parity. missing for 10: documented parity between API and UI across all features (dashboards, alerts, SLOs, settings), a published OpenAPI or full API reference (probe found none), and independent corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: NerdGraph is our GraphQL-format API that lets you query New Relic data and configure some New Relic features.
You can use the New Relic CLI to manage entity tags, define workloads, record deployment markers, and much more.
The New Relic CLI enables the integration of New Relic into your existing workflows.
New Relic Agent Control with Terraform provides a powerful, declarative solution for managing fleets of agents at scale.
